author: imryaan
body:
So recently there has been a lot of spammers who've been spamming racist slurs, swastikas, xenophobic slurs etc and sometimes there is only one junior mod online and they have literally no power against them other than just spam-kicking them.
I suggest that instead of wasting time adding useless badge shops, the devs add something like an anti-spam plugin which could actually be useful?

And also, I can't believe why this hasn't been added yet because people can just spam all they like when there's no mods online.
